# fastlane

**Tag**: devops

## 简介

The easiest way to automate beta deployments and releases for your iOS and Android apps

## 官网

- 主页: https://fastlane.tools
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane
- 文档: https://docs.fastlane.tools/
- 更新日志: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/releases
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/fastlane
